clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Cask of Merlot supplies Lakeshire while Blackrock orcs cut its trade routes.

Harvested and fermented in the heart of the kingdom, the merlot comes from the Galina Winery's cellars. The winery lies along the canals bordering Stormwind's Trade District, where winemaker Roberto Pupellyverbos tends its vintages for the capital's refined tastes. Unlike Duskwood moonshine or Elwynn spirits, this wine reflects the craft of human vintners working within the city's walls.

When the Blackrock clan invaded the Redridge Mountains, supply routes failed and Lakeshire lost its usual merchant shipments. With locals parched and terrified, Barkeep Daniels sends willing couriers across the kingdom to refill his tavern's cellars. The cask gives defenders and refugees by Lake Everstill a gentle drink to wash down their rations.
